personality_one_liner: A crisp, authoritative, and frictionless daily tracker ensuring campus safety with clarity and precision.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding. Group related elements tightly (xs/sm) and separate distinct sections generously (xl/2xl). Use 'safe-area' for screens without headers.

do's: Tab bar when content scrolls behind
Sticky filter rows on presence board
Header over the campus/map background on the check-in screen

screens.name: Live Presence Board (Home)
screens.purpose: A live directory showing exactly who is on campus, who has exited, who is on tour, and who is on leave.

states.empty: Empty marina dock illustration 'Campus is empty today'
states.error: Failed to load presence data + Retry button

screens.layout: Sticky header with Segmented Control for filtering (All, On Campus, Exited, Leave/Tour). Scrollable list of Member Cards. Member Card: row direction, Avatar left, Name & Role center, colored presence badge (Green = On Campus, Gray = Exited, Orange = On Tour, Yellow = On Leave) right.

screens.name: Check-In / Out (Scanner)
screens.purpose: Camera interface to scan the Office Station QR code, verify GPS within 100m, and capture an entry photo.

states.error: Error modal if GPS too far or QR invalid

screens.layout: Full-bleed camera view. Glassmorphism header. Centered scanning frame overlay. Bottom container (glass or solid inverse) with 'Check In' / 'Check Out' large primary CTA and instructional text.

screens.name: Member Profile & Leave
screens.purpose: Shows member's logged hours, recent attendance, and a form to apply for leave.
screens.layout: Top section: Profile banner (Yacht club background photo with vertical gradient scrim), overlapping avatar, Name, Role. Middle section: Quick stats (Hours on campus this week, attendance %). Bottom section: Recent logs list or Leave Application form toggle.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard & Reports
screens.purpose: Admin view to manage members, export weekly/monthly/daily reports, and approve leaves.
screens.layout: Grid of summary cards (Total On Campus, Pending Leaves). List of quick actions (Export Daily Report, Manage Office QR). List rows for pending leave approvals.

empty_dock.alt: Empty marina dock on a clear day

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette (No Blues allowed, use Dark Slate/Graphite as brand).
Implement clear visual hierarchy for the Live Presence Board: use semantic colors for status (Green for On Campus, Gray for Exited, Amber/Orange for On Tour, Yellow for On Leave).
QR Check-In requires Camera and Location permissions. Mock the GPS (simulate 100m) and QR validation if needed, but build the UI correctly.
Ensure all backgrounds with images (e.g., Profile cover banner) use the mandatory 3-stop top-to-bottom gradient scrim to preserve readability.
For the scanner screen, use a full-bleed camera interface with a translucent overlay/frame to guide the user, and a sticky glassmorphic bottom pane for instructions and CTA.
Ensure all floating components (FABs, sticky action buttons) handle Safe Area properly and don't double-count paddings.
